title: Core etale polynomial chart construction with canonical constants
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, n and c natural numbers, and f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R. Assume the quotient C = MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f) is smooth over R. Let b be a Module.Basis (Fin c) C (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent whose j-th basis vector is the canonical cotangent class of f j for every j. Then there exist g in MvPolynomial (Fin c) C with constantCoeff g = 1 and an R-algebra homomorphism θ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] Localization.Away g such that θ.toRingHom.toAlgebra is étale and θ.toRingHom.comp MvPolynomial.C = Algebra.ofId R (Localization.Away g).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_polynomial_chart_core
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    [Smooth R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin c)
      (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
      (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent)
    (hb : ∀ j : Fin c,
      b j = (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).toCotangent
        ⟨f j, Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j)⟩) :
    ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin c) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)),
      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff g = 1 ∧
      ∃ θ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] Localization.Away g,
        @Etale (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away g) _ _
            θ.toRingHom.toAlgebra ∧
          θ.toRingHom.comp MvPolynomial.C = Algebra.ofId R (Localization.Away g)
